messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: sustained KV cache page churn > 95% capacity on region-eu-west continuous-batcher. Error ratio for /v1/generate rising. Paging on-call.

Morgan: I'm oncall SRE. seeing rapid kv_cache.page_count growth and lots of page_write_retries. p95 gen latency jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s in last 20m.

Kevin: linking this to last night's cont-batch rollout (config push at 02:44 UTC). new defaults were larger: `cont_batch.max_batch_tokens=49152` and `cont_batch.max_num_seqs=48`.

Sophia: on prod traces the big batches correlate with long user sequences + streaming clients. KV pages are being populated with very large prefix states and eviction can't keep up.

Morgan: ops-bot please create incident record.

Ops-bot: Created INC-2059 - Continuous batching config regression causing KV cache blowup. Severity=P1. Detected tenants affected: hw-analytics, partner-b, retail-eu. Noted 502s for a small fraction of requests.

Morgan: mitigation options: 1) revert config to previous safe values 2) enable kv_cache.fast_eviction 3) add per-tenant batch caps (soft throttle) 4) scale up batch workers to buy time. I'll start with #1 and #2.

Kevin: preparing revert. patch: ```diff
- cont_batch.max_batch_tokens=49152
- cont_batch.max_num_seqs=48
+ cont_batch.max_batch_tokens=8192
+ cont_batch.max_num_seqs=16
```

Owen: while revert rolls, I'll flip runtime flag for eviction: `set_runtime_flag region-eu-west kv_cache.eviction_mode fast` and enable `kv_cache.eviction_aggressiveness=high`. also dribble traffic from heavy tenants to small-model variants: `route 5% hw-analytics -> model-small-v2`.

Morgan: executing rollback: `./deploy config cont-batch --version=1.8.7 --canary=4`

Ops-bot: Deploy started by morgan at 2058881305. Canary nodes: batch-eu-03 batch-eu-07 batch-eu-09 batch-eu-11.

Sophia: quick note: we hit cont-batch.request_timeout frequently as some requests were stalled behind eviction. increased `cont_batch.request_timeout` 6s->10s to avoid client 5xx during mitigation. mark this TODO to revert later.

Kevin: Canary looks good on three hosts, batch-eu-09 had higher disk latency but health checks passed. proceeding full rollout.

Morgan: rollback completed at 2058881420. kv_cache.page_count stopped rising; bytes falling from 360GB -> 150GB over 8 minutes. p95 latency back near baseline ~160ms.

Diane-cs: Customer report: partner-b saw intermittent 502s and elevated latency starting ~2058881150. They've asked for timeline and whether data was lost.

Morgan: interim customer note: "We observed a configuration change to continuous batching that increased default batch sizes, which caused excessive KV cache growth and transient errors. We rolled back the change and enabled eviction; service performance is restored. No data loss. Full RCA and timeline coming." I'll send within 20 minutes.

Owen: follow-ups: add config validator that rejects cont_batch.max_batch_tokens > 16384 for hosted, and max_num_seqs > 32. add runtime alert `kv_cache.page_write_rate > 800/s` and `kv_cache.eviction_failures > 5/min`.

Kevin: opening PR `infra/contbatch/guardrail` with validation and CI check. also adding a canary test that simulates long sequences in staging.

Morgan: handing off oncall to Kevin now `/handoff @kevin oncall until 2058920000`. Kevin please monitor for 4 hours.

Kevin: taking over. actions: 1) merge guardrail PR 2) schedule eviction revert test 3) revert temporary timeout bump during low traffic window 4) confirm no residual OOMs.

Diane-cs: I'll follow up with affected customers and initiate SLA credit review for partner-b.

Ops-bot: Incident INC-2059 updated: mitigations=rollback, fast-eviction, temporary-timeout-bump, small-model-dribble. status=mitigated.

Morgan: additional note: we should instrument per-tenant batch size distribution and add a synthetic load that exercises 30-60k token combined batches in staging to detect regressions.

Kevin: agreed. adding `perf/long-batch-canary` to nightly runs and a dashboard widget for `cont_batch.max_observed_batch_tokens`.

Sophia: I'll draft the postmortem with timeline, metrics, and the PR that introduced the bad defaults. assign owner for remediation: Kevin (config guardrail), Morgan (deploy/runbooks), Owen (eviction tuning), Diane-cs (cust comms).

Morgan: thanks all. I'll keep an eye on alerts for the next 3h. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: RESOLVE: INC-2059 marked mitigated at 2058881599. Postmortem scheduled.
